_comment: Term table template. Copy to glossary.json and fill in. This is the single source of truth for recurring names; feed it to the translator with every batch and apply it across all carriers AFTER the main translation pass. Keep it out of any published build.
_rules: Match longest source term first, so a compound name is not split by its own prefix.
Never apply a term inside an identifier: plugin command names, parameter keys, note tag names, resource file names.
Preserve control codes and placeholders verbatim: \N[n] \V[n] \C[n] \I[n] \G and %1-style placeholders.
After applying, re-run the audit to catch terms that re-contaminated already-translated text.

do_not_translate.SOURCE_TERM: reason - identifier looked up by name / matched by a plugin / proper noun of a real person
